title: World forest area summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Ritchie, Roser), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): the world has about 4 billion hectares of forest (a little over one-third of habitable land, around one-quarter of all land); Russia has the largest area (over 800 million hectares, one-fifth of the global total); Brazil is the only other country with more than 10% of global forest cover. Figures verified consistent (800M is one-fifth of 4 billion; one-third of habitable land is about one-quarter of all land; Brazil is second so under 800M) before injecting 3 defects.
